task_completion.visual_evidence: Specific residues (594-596) rendered in a different color or representation (e.g., sticks) compared to the rest of the protein.

task_completion.description: Measure the distance between the C-alpha (CA) atoms of Phe595 in the aligned structures.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement line or label in the PyMOL viewer connecting the two Phe595 residues, with a numerical value displayed.

privileged_info_for_vlm: 3OG7 is BRAF bound to Vemurafenib in the 'DFG-in' (active) conformation. 1UWH is BRAF bound to Sorafenib in the 'DFG-out' (inactive) conformation. The distance between Phe595 CA atoms in these two states is typically between 10 and 15 Angstroms. Sorafenib is a Type II inhibitor that binds to the DFG-out state, occupying an allosteric hydrophobic pocket adjacent to the ATP-binding site that is only available in the DFG-out conformation.
